comment: The END output and the two displays are refreshed only once every thousand and one process calls (Collatz.cpp:130), so the END gate can lag the end of a chain by a few milliseconds. The accent count is the current number divided by the gate count, taken modulo the modulus, and is forced to zero when the gate count is zero to avoid dividing by it (Collatz.cpp:223).
